entities.name: Simon Mdivani

entities.summary: Simon Mdivani, was a Georgian politician member of the Georgian Socialist-Federalist Revolutionary Party, exiled in Turkey, then in France following the invasion of his country by the Red Army, and died on December 13, 1937, in Sceaux.
